requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 1. Purpose
requirements.quote: The API lets the mobile app upload images of the applicant's identity document (ID card of the Republic of Kazakhstan or passport) and a selfie during remote onboarding, submit them for verification and query the verification status.
requirements.summary: API загружает фото ID-карты РК или паспорта и селфи, отправляет их на проверку и отдаёт статус проверки

requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 2. General rules
requirements.quote: 2.1. All endpoints are served over HTTPS only, TLS 1.2 or higher; plain HTTP requests are rejected without redirect.
requirements.summary: Все эндпоинты только по HTTPS с TLS 1.2+; HTTP-запросы отклоняются без редиректа

requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 2. General rules
requirements.quote: 2.2. Every request carries Authorization: Bearer <access_token> issued to the onboarding session. The access token lifetime is 15 minutes.
requirements.summary: Каждый запрос несёт Bearer-токен сессии онбординга; время жизни токена 15 минут

requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 2. General rules
requirements.quote: 2.3. All timestamps are ISO 8601 strings in UTC, e.g. 2026-11-12T09:30:00Z.
requirements.summary: Все временные метки в формате ISO 8601 в UTC

requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 2. General rules
requirements.quote: 2.4. Every POST request must carry an Idempotency-Key header (UUID v4). A repeated request with the same key within 24 hours returns the original response and does not create a new upload.
requirements.summary: Каждый POST содержит Idempotency-Key (UUID v4); повтор с тем же ключом за 24 часа возвращает исходный ответ

requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 2. General rules
requirements.quote: 2.5. The applicant is identified by IIN (12 digits). Test IIN for examples: 000000000000.
requirements.summary: Заявитель идентифицируется по ИИН из 12 цифр

requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 2. General rules
requirements.quote: 2.6. The client app compresses images, strips EXIF location data, shows a progress bar and retries failed uploads up to 3 times.
requirements.summary: Клиентское приложение сжимает изображения, удаляет EXIF-геоданные, показывает прогресс и повторяет отправку до 3 раз

requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 3. Endpoints › 3.1. POST /v1/onboarding/{sessionId}/documents
requirements.quote: Uploads one document image. Request body: multipart/form-data.
requirements.summary: POST документа загружает одно изображение документа в формате multipart/form-data

requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 3. Endpoints › 3.1. POST /v1/onboarding/{sessionId}/documents
requirements.quote: Parameter: sessionId | In: path | Type: string (UUID) | Required: yes | Rules: Onboarding session id
requirements.summary: Параметр sessionId: путь, UUID, обязателен

requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 3. Endpoints › 3.1. POST /v1/onboarding/{sessionId}/documents
requirements.quote: Parameter: iin | In: query | Type: string | Required: yes | Rules: Applicant IIN, 12 digits
requirements.summary: Параметр iin: query, строка из 12 цифр, обязателен

requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 3. Endpoints › 3.1. POST /v1/onboarding/{sessionId}/documents
requirements.quote: Parameter: docType | In: form | Type: string | Required: yes | Rules: ID_CARD, PASSPORT, SELFIE
requirements.summary: Параметр docType: form, обязателен; значения ID_CARD, PASSPORT, SELFIE

requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 3. Endpoints › 3.1. POST /v1/onboarding/{sessionId}/documents
requirements.quote: Parameter: side | In: form | Type: string | Required: for ID_CARD only | Rules: FRONT or BACK
requirements.summary: Параметр side: form, обязателен только для ID_CARD; значения FRONT или BACK

requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 3. Endpoints › 3.1. POST /v1/onboarding/{sessionId}/documents
requirements.quote: Parameter: file | In: form | Type: binary | Required: yes | Rules: JPEG or PNG, max 10 MB
requirements.summary: Параметр file: binary, обязателен; JPEG или PNG, не более 10 МБ

requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 3. Endpoints › 3.1. POST /v1/onboarding/{sessionId}/documents
requirements.quote: 201 Created — upload accepted: {"documentId": "d-001", "status": "RECEIVED"}
requirements.summary: Успешная загрузка отвечает 201 с documentId и статусом RECEIVED

requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 3. Endpoints › 3.1. POST /v1/onboarding/{sessionId}/documents
requirements.quote: 400 Bad Request — a parameter is missing or invalid
requirements.summary: Отсутствующий или неверный параметр возвращает 400

requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 3. Endpoints › 3.1. POST /v1/onboarding/{sessionId}/documents
requirements.quote: 413 Payload Too Large — the file exceeds the size limit
requirements.summary: Файл сверх лимита размера возвращает 413

requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 3. Endpoints › 3.1. POST /v1/onboarding/{sessionId}/documents
requirements.quote: 415 Unsupported Media Type — the file is not JPEG or PNG
requirements.summary: Файл не JPEG или PNG возвращает 415

requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 3. Endpoints › 3.1. POST /v1/onboarding/{sessionId}/documents
requirements.quote: 422 Unprocessable Entity — image quality is insufficient, see 4.3
requirements.summary: Недостаточное качество изображения возвращает 422 (ссылка на 4.3, которого нет)

requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 3. Endpoints › 3.1. POST /v1/onboarding/{sessionId}/documents
requirements.quote: If a document of the same docType and side has already been uploaded in the session, the server returns 409.
requirements.summary: Повторная загрузка того же docType и side в сессии возвращает 409

requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 3. Endpoints › 3.1. POST /v1/onboarding/{sessionId}/documents
requirements.quote: The upload endpoint responds within 3 seconds.
requirements.summary: Эндпоинт загрузки отвечает не дольше 3 секунд

requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 3. Endpoints › 3.2. GET /v1/onboarding/{sessionId}/status
requirements.quote: Returns the verification status of the session. Authorization is not required for this endpoint so that the web landing page can poll it.
requirements.summary: GET статуса сессии доступен без авторизации, чтобы лендинг мог опрашивать его

requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 3. Endpoints › 3.2. GET /v1/onboarding/{sessionId}/status
requirements.summary: Ответ статуса содержит sessionId, status, ФИО, ИИН, дату рождения и номер документа

requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 3. Endpoints › 3.2. GET /v1/onboarding/{sessionId}/status
requirements.quote: Session status values: DRAFT, SUBMITTED, PROCESSING, VERIFIED, REJECTED.
requirements.summary: Значения статуса сессии: DRAFT, SUBMITTED, PROCESSING, VERIFIED, REJECTED

requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 3. Endpoints › 3.3. GET /v1/onboarding/{sessionId}/documents/{documentId}/delete
requirements.quote: Removes a previously uploaded document. A document can be removed only while the session status is DRAFT; otherwise the server returns 400.
requirements.summary: Удаление документа возможно только в статусе DRAFT, иначе 400

requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 3. Endpoints › 3.4. POST /v1/onboarding/{sessionId}/submit
requirements.quote: Submits all uploaded documents for verification. The session must contain an ID card (both sides) or a passport, and one selfie; otherwise 400 with {"error": "INCOMPLETE_SET"}. On success the status becomes SUBMITTED and the server returns 202 Accepted.
requirements.summary: Отправка требует ID-карту (обе стороны) или паспорт и селфи, иначе 400 INCOMPLETE_SET; успех дает 202 и статус SUBMITTED

requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 3. Endpoints › 3.4. POST /v1/onboarding/{sessionId}/submit
requirements.quote: The verification provider is called asynchronously. When it responds, the status changes to PROCESSING and then to APPROVED or REJECTED. If the verification provider fails, the session is handled accordingly.
requirements.summary: Провайдер проверки вызывается асинхронно; статусы PROCESSING затем APPROVED или REJECTED; сбой провайдера не описан

requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 4. Image quality
requirements.quote: 4.1. Minimum resolution of a document image is 1280×720 pixels; a selfie is at least 640×480 pixels.
requirements.summary: Минимальное разрешение: документ 1280×720 px, селфи 640×480 px

requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 4. Image quality
requirements.quote: 4.2. Glare and blur on the document image must be within acceptable limits.
requirements.summary: Блики и размытие на изображении документа должны быть в допустимых пределах

requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 4. Image quality
requirements.quote: Liveness of the selfie is checked by the FaceCheck SDK 4.2 library on the server in a dedicated thread pool of 8 workers.
requirements.summary: Проверку живости селфи выполняет FaceCheck SDK 4.2 на сервере в пуле из 8 потоков

requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 5. Limits
requirements.quote: Limit: Maximum file size | Value: 8 000 KB
requirements.summary: Максимальный размер файла 8 000 КБ

requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 5. Limits
requirements.quote: Limit: Supported formats | Value: JPEG, PNG, HEIC
requirements.summary: Поддерживаемые форматы: JPEG, PNG, HEIC

requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 5. Limits
requirements.quote: Limit: Uploads per session | Value: at most 20
requirements.summary: Не более 20 загрузок на сессию

requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 5. Limits
requirements.quote: Limit: Rate limit | Value: 30 requests per applicant
requirements.summary: Лимит частоты: 30 запросов на заявителя (период не указан)

requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 6. Data retention
requirements.quote: 6.1. Document images and selfies are stored for 90 days after the onboarding session ends and are then permanently deleted.
requirements.summary: Изображения и селфи хранятся 90 дней после окончания сессии, затем удаляются навсегда

requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 6. Data retention
requirements.quote: 6.2. Images are stored encrypted with AES-256; keys are managed by the bank's HSM.
requirements.summary: Изображения шифруются AES-256; ключи управляются HSM банка

requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 7. Audit
requirements.quote: 7.1. Every upload, deletion and status change is written to the audit log with sessionId, documentId, operation and timestamp.
requirements.summary: Каждая загрузка, удаление и смена статуса пишется в аудит с sessionId, documentId, операцией и временем

requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 7. Audit
requirements.quote: 7.2. Original document images are retained for the whole term of the business relationship and for 5 years after it ends, as required by AML regulations.
requirements.summary: Оригиналы хранятся весь срок отношений и 5 лет после их окончания по требованиям AML

requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 8. Acceptance criteria
requirements.quote: #: AC-1 | Given: Session in DRAFT | When: Upload a 2 MB JPEG ID_CARD FRONT | Then: 201, status RECEIVED
requirements.summary: Загрузка 2 МБ JPEG ID_CARD FRONT в DRAFT дает 201 и статус RECEIVED

requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 8. Acceptance criteria
requirements.quote: #: AC-2 | Given: Session in DRAFT | When: Upload a GIF file | Then: 415
requirements.summary: Загрузка GIF в DRAFT дает 415

requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 8. Acceptance criteria
requirements.quote: #: AC-3 | Given: Any session | When: Repeat POST with the same Idempotency-Key within 24 hours | Then: Original response, no new document
requirements.summary: Повтор POST с тем же Idempotency-Key за 24 часа возвращает исходный ответ без нового документа

requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 8. Acceptance criteria
requirements.quote: #: AC-4 | Given: Session in SUBMITTED | When: Delete a document | Then: 400
requirements.summary: Удаление документа в статусе SUBMITTED дает 400

requirements.section: Remote Onboarding — Identity Document Upload API › 8. Acceptance criteria
requirements.quote: #: AC-5 | Given: Session with 3 rejected selfies | When: Upload a 4th selfie | Then: 423 Locked for 24 hours
requirements.summary: Четвёртое селфи после трёх отклонённых дает 423 Locked на 24 часа
